description_en: This API retrieves results for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from one or more folder or file IDs. You can then process these results and embed them in your business logic
description_zh: 支持多文件夹ID或文件ID检索的RAG结果获取接口，供客户端自行加工结果并嵌入业务逻辑
kebab_example: aliyun energyexpertexternal retrieve --query What_s_the_meaning_of_the_file0 --use-reranker true --reranker-threshold 0.0 --topk 10 --pre-retrieve-topk 0 --document-ids 3456 --folder-ids adafb91d4e014e2eb4d0a5375b547115 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Retrieve

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to use the reranker. Default: true.
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the reranker. Default: true
parameters.name: use_reranker

parameters.description_en: The reranking score threshold. Results with scores below this threshold are filtered out. Default: 0.0.
parameters.description_zh: 重排序分数阈值，低于该阈值的结果会被过滤（默认0.0）
parameters.help_en: The reranking score threshold. Results with scores below this threshold are filtered out. Default: 0.0
parameters.help_zh: 重排序分数阈值，低于该阈值的结果会被过滤（默认0.0）
parameters.name: reranker_threshold

parameters.description_en: The number of top-ranked retrieval results to return. Default: 10.
parameters.description_zh: 返回召回结果的Top-K条目（默认10）
parameters.help_en: The number of top-ranked retrieval results to return. Default: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回召回结果的Top-K条目（默认10）
parameters.name: topk

parameters.description_en: The number of pre-retrieval results to return. Default: 0.
parameters.description_zh: 返回预召回的召回数（默认0）
parameters.help_en: The number of pre-retrieval results to return. Default: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回预召回的召回数（默认0）
parameters.name: pre_retrieve_topk

parameters.description_en: Specify either documentIds or folderIds, but not both.
